title: Go Forth and Tell
lyrics_original: Go forth and tell! O Church of God, awake!
God's saving news to all the nations take.
Proclaim Christ Jesus, Savior, Lord, and King,
That all the world His worthy praise may sing.
Go forth and tell! God offers life to all;
The Lord makes rich all who on Him shall call.
How shall they call if they have never heard
The gracious invitation of His Word?
Go forth and tell! Men still in darkness lie;
In wealth or want, in sin they live and die.
Give us, O Lord, concern of heart and mind-
A love like Yours which cares for all mankind.
Go forth and tell! Christ charges us to go.
All power is His; from Him the blessings flow.
Live out your life as Christ your Lord shall choose;
Your ransomed powers for His sole glory use.
Go forth and tell! O Church of God, arise!
Go in the strength which Christ your Lord supplies.
Go 'til all nations His great name adore,
And serve Him Lord and King forever more.

bible_verses.english: Go, and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?
He said to them, “Go into all the world, and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for the incredible gift of Your salvation and the mercy You have showered upon my life. Stir my heart today with a fresh compassion for those who do not yet know Your love. Give me the courage to share Your good news with gentle boldness in my daily interactions. Use my words and life to point others to You, so that many may sing Your worthy praise. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: The gospel is a joyful gift meant to be shared, not kept to ourselves. "Go Forth and Tell" gently reminds us that behind every face in our daily lives is a soul longing for the hope and life found in Jesus. As we sing these words, we are invited to wake up to the beauty of our calling—to be humble bearers of Christ’s light and grace in a world searching for truth. May our hearts burn with the desire to make His invitation known.
